data: Does the y-axis represent the BLUE scores?

The y-axis represents the log-probability values, not the BLEU scores. The caption explicitly states that the y-axis shows the log-probability values. Additionally, the scatter plot is titled "Scatter plot showing log-probability and BLEU of samples drawn from the model," which further confirms that the y-axis represents the log-probability values.
